text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-ap-southeast-1 saturated — queue length for inference-service > 1200 and autoscaler failing to provision GPUs (errors seen). Paging oncall.

alex: seeing it, thanks. autoscaler logs show repeated quota errors from AWS when requesting new instances.

maya: yep, same. error snippets: `CapacityError: You have no remaining vGPU quota in ap-southeast-1 for p4d` — but account shows quota increase request approved earlier today.

jordan: did the quota request go through a propagation window? sometimes it takes ~30-60m to apply.

lia: customer impact: started to see 503s on hosted API around +2m, backlog growing. routing fallback hit but drained quickly, we have degraded latency for some tenants.

infra-sre: pulling autoscaler logs now. attaching relevant lines:

```
Requesting 4 x p4d for pool-inference-ap-southeast-1
AWS API -> Response: 403 QuotaExceeded: Quota limit exceeded for resource: p4d
Retrying (1/5) after 3s
AWS API -> Response: 403 QuotaExceeded: Quota limit exceeded for resource: p4d
Failed to provision instances, marking attempt as failed
```

alex: good. I can see a quota increase ticket id aws-req-98823 with status=APPROVED from 2123455000. If propagation delay, autoscaler will keep hitting old limit.

maya: can we short-circuit by spinning up smaller instance types as a temporary fallback? e.g., p3->p3dn or g4dn? workload requires large memory for KV cache, but we can run reduced-concurrency shards.

jordan: autoscaler policy currently restricts to p4d and p3dn only. we could allow g4dn as emergency fallback, but need config change and a quick rollout.

lia: meanwhile customers are seeing increased error rate — doing a quick triage matrix: top 5 tenants by qps impacted: alpha-corp, beta-saas, test-proto. Not full outage but heavy degradation.

infra-sre: proposing quick mitigation plan: (1) edit autoscaler pool to allow g4dn fallback (2) reduce batch size to lower per-GPU memory, (3) add soft-limit to queue to return 429 for non-privileged clients to protect SLAs for premium tenants.

alex: I can patch autoscaler config and kick a canary in staging, then promote. doing a rolling config change now: `kubectl apply -f autoscaler/fallback-g4dn.yaml`

maya: tagging @cloud-support-bot — please verify quota propagation state with AWS console + support escalation if needed.

cloud-support-bot: AWS support case 555123 opened referencing quota change request aws-req-98823. Current note: Approved but not yet enforced; support escalated to provisioning team. ETA unknown.

infra-sre: can we also force-resync with the cloud API? our cache of account quotas may be stale. I'll trigger a resync call to the quota service.

jordan: resync returned: account quotas still show old values to our API (p4d: 0 available). So propagation hasn't hit the read side.

alex: can we manually provision on a different account/infra project as a last resort and route a subset of traffic? That needs policy signoff.

lia: we should prioritize premium tenants — enabling 429 for free-tier would help headroom. I'll prepare a temporary rate-limit rule and push it to the edge router.

maya: config change ready for autoscaler fallback. Performing canary cut to 10% of the pool.

```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/autoscaler FALLBACK_INSTANCE_TYPES="g4dn.xlarge,g4dn.2xlarge"
# restart autoscaler
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler
```

infra-sre: canary looks good after 60s. New instances requested: 2 x g4dn.2xlarge accepted and came up. latency for canary traffic improved ~35%.

alex: continuing rollout to 50% now. monitoring for QoE regressions.

lia: edge rule deployed: non-paid routes now receive `429` when queue > 800. Should free up capacity for premium tenants.

maya: alert suppression for noisy quota alarms enabled until we have final state.

cloud-support-bot: AWS support updated: "Quota enforcement is being migrated; expected propagation within next 20-45 minutes. We cannot expedite further via API."

jordan: summary of actions so far: (1) allowed g4dn fallback and rolled to 50% pool, (2) reduced batch size on new nodes via runtime flag, (3) edge rate-limit for non-paid customers, (4) opened support case and resync. Queue is decreasing from 1200 -> 420 over 18m.

alex: next steps: finish rollout if metrics continue to improve, keep support case open until quota reads show updated values, and schedule a postmortem to look at propagation handling and autoscaler fallback automation.

lia: notifying affected account teams and CS now with incident severity and mitigations.

maya: adding follow-up TODOs: add autoscaler health check to detect persistent quota errors and auto-enable safe fallback set, add circuit-breaker to return 429 earlier to protect premium SLAs.

oncall-bot: Incident severity set to SEV-2. Incident channel created: #incident-2123456789-autoscale-quota-propagation.

alex: closing immediate paging loop — will keep monitoring for 30m then update this thread with final state. :white_check_mark:
